title: Sweeper Ultra
short: Sudoku's rules, Minesweeper's nerve: one icon per row, column and section.
full:
Sweeper Ultra is a logic puzzle with Sudoku's rules and Minesweeper's nerve.

Every board is split into coloured sections. Place exactly one icon in every row, every column and every section, and never let two icons touch, not even diagonally. Tap a square to mark it with an X, then double-tap to place your icon. A wrong guess costs a misfire. Run out and the level is over.

★ PURE LOGIC
• Easy and Medium boards have exactly one solution, so careful thinking always wins.
• Mark squares with X, or with ? when you only suspect an icon.

★ FROM 5×5 TO 50×50
• Easy 5×5, Medium up to 10×10, Hard 20×20 to 30×30 and Nightmare 50×50.
• Pinch to zoom into giant boards and use the minimap to find your way.

★ A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• The Daily Puzzle is free for everyone. Solve it every day to grow your streak.

★ PLAY YOUR WAY
• 17 icons, including five cute characters, 5 colour palettes and a colour-blind mode.
• Auto-Fill, hints, long-press placing and Fat Fingers help for tiny squares.

★ CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS
• Google Play Games leaderboards for every difficulty and the Daily Puzzle.
• Three stars for a perfect board, and every best time is tracked.

★ FAIR AND SIMPLE
• The first 200 levels of every difficulty and the Daily Puzzle are free.
• One small purchase unlocks unlimited levels and Nightmare forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no coins.
• Plays offline in 41 languages.
